title: noor ki hai ye mehfil hai yaha'n ali akber
body:
noor ki hai ye mehfil hai yaha'n ali akbar
jashn ka hasee'n unwaan noujawa'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
tera jashn karte hai bazm ham sajaate hai
ilteja hai tu aaja ab yahan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
karta hu sana teri or yaqeen hai mujhko
hai malaaeka meri hamzabaa'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj phir zaroorat hai muntazar sama'at hai
phir se lehne ahmad me de azaa'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
husn hai mohammad ka aur sin hai zahra ka
kya raqam karu teri qoobiya'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
kalmagoh mohammad ke ghar bulaaenge tujh ko
denge kis tarah aaqar wo azaa'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
aati hai wahan zainab saath umme laila ke
tere zikr ki mehfil ho jahan ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
shaad ibne hyder hai aaj jashne akbar hai
muskuraake kehti hai har zabaa'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
tu saqi ka pota hai tu saqi ka beta hai
bhar de aaj in sab ke jholiya'n ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
haazereene mehfil ki har muraad bar aaye
dekhe'n jald sab tera aastaa'n ali akbar
